name: The Last Coach
summary: A three-hour one-shot. The coach out of town leaves at dawn, and someone on it should not be.
about:
For three or four players at level 1, in an evening.

The party are strangers sharing the last coach before the pass closes for winter. One of the other passengers is being hunted; one of them is doing the hunting; the driver knows and has been paid not to. It ends when the coach reaches the pass -- whoever is still on it.

Original material, so it ships with the app. Logins are 'one', 'two', 'three' with the password 'the-pass-closes'.

entities.name: Wren Calloway
entities.summary: A courier who has made this run before, and is nervous about this one.

data.party_knows: Knows the road. Keeps checking behind.

entities.name: Brother Matthias
entities.summary: A travelling priest, going wherever he is sent.

data.party_knows: Kind, and asks a great many questions.

entities.name: Old Pell
entities.summary: Drives the coach. Has driven it thirty years.

data.motive: get through the pass and be paid
data.secrets: Took forty gold to make one extra stop tonight, and not to mention it.

entities.name: Miren Ashe
entities.summary: A quiet passenger with a good coat and no luggage.

data.motive: reach the far side of the pass alive
data.secrets: Witnessed a killing in the town behind them and is the only one who can name who did it.

entities.name: Sera Vance
entities.summary: A passenger who boarded late and travels light.

data.motive: make sure Miren Ashe does not reach the far side
data.secrets: Paid the driver for the extra stop. Intends to use it.

entities.name: The North Road
entities.summary: Six hours of dark between the town and the pass.

data.shared_notes: Frozen ruts, black trees, and no lights between here and the pass.

entities.name: The Coach
entities.summary: Six seats, one lamp, and nowhere to go.

data.shared_notes: Cramped, cold, and everyone can hear everything.

entities.name: The Water Stop
entities.summary: A trough, a lean-to, and no reason to stop tonight.

entities.name: The Pass
entities.summary: Where the road ends and the evening does.

storyline.title: Boarding
storyline.read_aloud: Six seats, five passengers, and a driver who wants to leave. The pass closes with the first snow, and the sky has that low grey look. This is the last coach.
storyline.done_when: Everyone has spoken once and the coach is moving.

storyline.title: Three hours of dark
storyline.read_aloud: Nobody sleeps. The lamp swings. Sera asks good questions; Miren answers as few as politeness allows.
storyline.done_when: The party has formed an opinion about at least one of the two.

storyline.title: The stop that should not happen
storyline.read_aloud: The coach slows. There is nothing here but a trough and a lean-to, and Old Pell does not explain.
storyline.done_when: The party works out the stop was bought, or fails to and it is used.

storyline.title: Whoever moves first
storyline.done_when: Sera acts, or is stopped before she can.

storyline.title: The pass, and who is still on the coach
storyline.read_aloud: The snow starts as the road tips downward. Behind you, the pass is already closing.
storyline.done_when: The coach reaches the pass. Whoever is on it, that is the ending.
